about: Forms met in a game that show their species' picture: PokéAPI has no Pokémon HOME render for them (Partner Pikachu and Partner Eevee look like Pikachu and Eevee). Every other form needs its own picture: public/sizes/art/256/{id}.webp for a form with a PokéAPI id, public/tools/nuzlocke/forms/{species}-{form}.webp for a cosmetic form (scripts/nuzlocke-art.ts makes both). npm run verify:nuzlocke fails on any other form without one, and on an entry here that gets a picture or stops being used.
